<panel>
	<name>DProgress</name>
	<parent>Panel</parent>
	<realm>Client and Menu</realm>
	<file line="">lua/vgui/dprogress.lua</file>
	<description>A progressbar, works with a fraction between 0 and 1 where 0 is 0% and 1 is 100%.</description>
</panel>


<example>
	<description>Creates a DProgress set to 75% (0.75 out of 1)</description>
	<code>
local DProgress = vgui.Create( "DProgress" )
DProgress:SetPos( 10, 30 )
DProgress:SetSize( 200, 20 )
DProgress:SetFraction( 0.75 )
	</code>
	<output><image src="DProgress_large.png"/></output>

</example>
